content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_OF_LEASE
content_blocks.text: The Lease Term shall commence on November 1, 2024, and shall expire on October 31, 2025.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200.00 per month, payable on the first day of each month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The Premises shall be used solely for residential purposes, as further defined in Exhibit A attached hereto.
